title: Slovakian Pork Stir Fry
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring tender pork, stir-fried with a variety of vegetables and served with warm, silky egg noodles.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cooked pork back into the skillet and stir in the Slovakian paprika. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the pork and vegetable mixture over warm egg noodles.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or dill, if desired.
